title: Heading Anchors for Jahia
voiceStyle: Young, bright and upbeat voice, smiling audibly all the way through, like an enthusiastic developer happily showing a neat little feature to friends. Positive and energetic but natural, never salesy. Clear articulation, lively pace, short pauses between sentences, same timbre and energy in every chapter.

chapters.title: Linking to a section
chapters.narration: Ever wanted to share a link to one specific section of a long page? Here is a page with several sections, but its headings have no anchors yet. Add a section name to the address, and the browser has nothing to jump to: the reader lands at the top and has to scroll and search. Let's fix that!

chapters.title: Enable the module on a site
chapters.narration: Heading Anchors solves this with one small module. Once it's deployed, open Administration, then Modules, find Heading Anchors, and enable it on the sites that need it. Sites without the module stay exactly as they are.

chapters.title: Readable anchors, below the sticky header
chapters.narration: Back on the page, nothing looks different, but every heading now has a clean, readable anchor, built from its text. And the same link now jumps right to the section. Notice the sticky header? The heading stops just below it, automatically. The module measures the header on every site, so there's nothing to set.

chapters.title: Configure it in the OSGi console
chapters.narration: Want more? Everything is configured in the OSGi console, under Tools. Open Configuration, then Heading anchors, and turn on the copy link button. Save, and it's live right away, no restart needed. And your configuration file survives module redeployments.

chapters.title: Copy a link in one click
chapters.narration: Reload the page and hover a heading: a small hash button pops up, with a Copy link tooltip. One click copies the full link to the section, and a short message confirms it. It works great with the keyboard too: tab to the button, and press Enter.

chapters.title: Every language and script
chapters.narration: The button and the messages speak the language of the page. Here is the French version, with Copier le lien. And anchors stay readable in every script: Cyrillic headings are transliterated, just like content system names, and Chinese headings keep their characters.

chapters.title: Existing and duplicated ids
chapters.narration: Ids that editors already typed are kept, and the button copies them as is. Two sections with the same title? Each one gets its own anchor, with a numbered suffix. And manual anchors from older workarounds are left untouched, unless you ask the module to adopt them.

chapters.title: Anchors follow the heading text
chapters.narration: Good to know: anchors are built from the heading text. Rename a heading, here Release cadence becomes Release schedule, and its anchor changes too, so older links to it won't find it anymore. Need a link that never changes? Simply type a fixed id on the heading in the editor, and the module keeps it.

chapters.title: Safe for every site
chapters.narration: The module is designed to stay out of your way. It never changes the page layout, its styles only touch what it adds, and it meets the WCAG 2.2 level AA accessibility requirements. Disable it on a site, and pages render exactly as before.

chapters.title: Get Heading Anchors
chapters.narration: Heading Anchors works with version 8.2.1 and later. Grab it from the Store, and find the code and the documentation on GitHub. Thanks for watching, and happy linking!
